record.title: WASA: WAtermark-based Source Attribution for Large Language Model-Generated Data
Dense Retrieval with Quantity Comparison Intent
Pruning General Large Language Models into Customized Expert Models
record.scope_reason: Cus-Prun is general expert-model pruning along language/domain/task dimensions. Physical pages 5–7 show multilingual MGSM/M3Exam/XQuAD/XLSum, medical/finance/social-media/e-commerce domain tasks, medical and Amazon summarization, and Amazon counterfactuals. Chinese-medical CMExam/HuatuoQA is an explicit two-dimensional demonstration, not the primary focus of the mixed-domain pruning study.

record.title: Enhance Multimodal Consistency and Coherence for Text-Image Plan Generation
record.scope_reason: Text-image planning spans daily how-to tasks. Physical page 3 documents wikiHow and Instructables plans covering home/garden, health, personal care, hobbies, cooking, vehicles, fitness, education and arts. Health is a minority category, not a biomedical-primary task.

record.title: Un-considering Contextual Information: Assessing LLMs’ Understanding of Indexical Elements
record.scope_reason: The English Indexical Dataset probes linguistic coreference for I, you, here and tomorrow using 1600 multiple-choice questions. It evaluates language-model semantics/pragmatics rather than clinical language or cognitive disorders.

record.title: Behavioral Analysis of Information Salience in Large Language Models
record.scope_reason: Information-salience analysis uses four parallel corpora. Physical page 4 lists 200 PubMed RCT abstracts, 185 NLP related-work sections, 106 astrophysics discussions and 90 meeting transcripts; page 7 human ratings span all four fields. The RCT/physician component is substantive but one domain of a general LLM-summarization behavior study.

record.title: The Behavior Gap: Evaluating Zero-shot LLM Agents in Complex Task-Oriented Dialogs
record.scope_reason: The behavior gap concerns task-oriented service agents. Physical page 3 evaluates MultiWOZ travel/booking, SpokenWOZ and proprietary product customer-support troubleshooting. It is not clinical communication or healthcare-agent evaluation.

record.title: Task Facet Learning: A Structured Approach To Prompt Optimization
record.scope_reason: UniPrompt is general prompt optimization. Physical pages 5, 7–8 evaluate Ethos hate speech, ARC science, MedQA, GSM8K, ten BBH tasks, medical QA comparisons with MedPrompt, HumanEval/MBPP code and proprietary query-intent equivalence. The medical comparison is a substantial subsection of a mixed-task study, not biomedical-primary.

record.title: LLM as Effective Streaming Processor: Bridging Streaming-Batch Mismatches with Group Position Encoding
record.scope_reason: Group position encoding addresses streaming text translation and ASR. Physical page 6 evaluates IWSLT-17 En-Fr/En-De and LibriSpeech. No medical speech or biomedical-primary translation task.

record.title: YinYang-Align: A new Benchmark for Competing Objectives and Introducing Multi-Objective Preference based Text-to-Image Alignment
record.scope_reason: YinYang-Align balances six conflicting text-to-image alignment objectives concerning fidelity, creativity, realism, emotional impact, verifiability and cultural sensitivity. The complete abstracts describe general image-generation alignment, not a biomedical target or clinical outcome.

record.title: FREE: Fast and Robust Vision Language Models with Early Exits
record.scope_reason: FREE is general vision-language early exit acceleration. Physical pages 6–7 evaluate COCO/NoCaps captioning, VQAv2/OK-VQA/GQA and VisDial. No biomedical images or clinical-primary task.

record.title: REPRO-Bench: Can Agentic AI Systems Assess the Reproducibility of Social Science Research?
record.scope_reason: REPRO-Bench assesses reproducibility of social-science research. Physical pages 3–4 define inclusion exclusively as social science and collect mostly economics/political-science reproduction reports plus social-science retractions and reports. Biomedical reproducibility in motivation/references is not the studied domain.

record.title: Time Travel: A Comprehensive Benchmark to Evaluate LMMs on Historical and Cultural Artifacts
record.scope_reason: TimeTravel is an expert-verified benchmark for historical/cultural artifacts, manuscripts, art, inscriptions and archaeology across 266 cultures. It is cultural-heritage understanding, not biomedical research.

record.title: Unveiling and Addressing Pseudo Forgetting in Large Language Models
record.scope_reason: Pseudo forgetting is a continual-learning phenomenon of models. Physical pages 7 and 13 specify fifteen generic CL/GLUE/SuperGLUE tasks on reviews, news, Wikipedia, Quora and lexical databases. Health/wellness is a topic-label example, not health measurement or a biomedical experiment.

record.title: Improving MLLM’s Document Image Machine Translation via Synchronously Self-reviewing Its OCR Proficiency
record.scope_reason: SSR improves document-image translation through OCR. Physical pages 4–5 and 8–9 show DoTA academic articles and DITrans political reports/advertisements/news, with DocVQA unsupervised data. Bilingual cognitive inspiration does not make the generic OCR/translation study biomedical.

record.title: HG-InsightLog: Context Prioritization and Reduction for Question Answering with Non-Natural Language Construct Log Data
record.scope_reason: HG-InsightLog answers questions over IT-system logs, using temporal hypergraphs of error codes, file paths and attribute values. This is technical log analysis, not clinical records or medical QA.

record.title: Dialect Normalization using Large Language Models and Morphological Rules
record.scope_reason: The normalization method combines Greek dialect morphology and LLMs on regional proverbs. It studies dialectal/standard linguistic transformations and semantic downstream observations, not health.

record.title: USDC: A Dataset of  ̲User  ̲Stance and  ̲Dogmatism in Long  ̲Conversations
record.scope_reason: USDC measures conversational stance and dogmatism rather than clinical mental health. Physical page 4 describes 764 threads and annotation tasks; page 13 lists 22 debate/politics/climate/animal-rights subreddits including abortion debates. These concern social opinions, not medical-outcome or psychiatric assessment.

record.title: Learning to Insert [PAUSE] Tokens for Better Reasoning
record.scope_reason: Dynamic pause-token insertion improves mathematical and programming reasoning on GSM8K, AQUA-RAT and MBPP. The complete abstract specifies no biomedical-primary task.

record.title: Understand the Implication: Learning to Think for Pragmatic Understanding
record.scope_reason: Thought-based pragmatic learning uses implication interpretation and transfers to presupposition/deixis. Social-cognition framing is linguistic model evaluation, not clinical cognition, patient data or mental-health assessment.

record.title: WASA: WAtermark-based Source Attribution for Large Language Model-Generated Data
record.scope_reason: WASA performs watermark-based training-source attribution. Physical pages 6–7 show arXiv research-field providers and BookSum book providers, measuring watermark/source accuracy and robustness. It is generic text/IP attribution, not biomedical evidence or clinical-source retrieval.

record.title: Dense Retrieval with Quantity Comparison Intent
record.scope_reason: DeepQuant is generic quantity-constrained dense retrieval. Physical page 6 evaluates FinQuant mixed news, MedQuant medical records/clinical trials and proprietary e-commerce; pages 8–9 add OpenFoodFacts synthetic numeric constraints and general MSMARCO. MedQuant is a genuine parallel benchmark, but medicine is not the primary problem or majority experimental focus.

record.title: KaFT: Knowledge-aware Fine-tuning for Boosting LLMs’ Domain-specific Question-Answering Performance
record.reason: Medical QA is the main actual experimental direction of this otherwise general knowledge-conflict fine-tuning method. Sections2.3/4.1 train on MedQA; Table2 and ablations analyze English/Chinese medical exams, and multilingual medical transfer is substantive. History/engineering/law serve OOD tests and later extensions; generic HaluEval is also reported. The paper explicitly frames those as generalization/additional applications (p8), and its conclusion returns to medical QA. Retain biomedical-main-experiments candidate, not inferred from dataset counts. Benchmark accuracy is not clinical validation. Formal Long/Short pending.

record.title: A rebuttal of two common deflationary stances against LLM cognition
record.scope_reason: The article critiques two philosophical deflationary arguments against LLM cognition. Physical pages 2–3 discuss simple training objectives and anthropomorphism with evolutionary, brain and animal analogies; it does not study a biomedical task, clinical population or original biological experiment.

record.title: COVER: Context-Driven Over-Refusal Verification in LLMs
record.scope_reason: COVER studies contextual over-refusal. Physical pages 3–4 explicitly choose Hadith and Sefaria/Talmud religious/legal corpora for QA, summarization and translation. Sensitive references are not a medical-primary evaluation.

record.title: MOSAIC: Multiple Observers Spotting AI Content
record.scope_reason: MOSAIC detects AI-generated text using model ensembles. Physical pages 5–6 evaluate RAID/RAID+ and multilingual M4 across diverse genres/generators, not biomedical-primary generated-text detection.

record.title: GUIDEX: Guided Synthetic Data Generation for Zero-Shot Information Extraction
record.scope_reason: GUIDEX creates generic IE schemas and synthetic labels. Physical pages 6–7 show biomedical BC5CDR/DIANN/NCBI among mixed training sources, but all seven zero-shot evaluation targets are AI, literature, music, science, politics, movies and restaurants. The main study is cross-domain NER, not biomedical-primary IE.

record.title: Missing the Margins: A Systematic Literature Review on the Demographic Representativeness of LLMs
record.scope_reason: The review surveys demographic representativeness of text LLMs across 211 empirical studies.
